walletAuthChallenge.title: Sign to verify your identity
walletAuthChallenge.description: SplitNaira needs to confirm that you control this wallet. You are being asked to sign a short message, not approve a payment or transfer any funds.
walletAuthChallenge.notPaymentDetail: No tokens will leave your wallet. Your signature only proves you own this address — it cannot authorise any transaction.
walletAuthChallenge.challengeExpiringSoon: Challenge expires in {seconds}s — please sign soon.
walletAuthChallenge.challengeExpiredDetail: For your security, challenges are single-use and time-limited. Request a new one to continue.
walletAuthChallenge.rejectedDetail: You dismissed the signing request in your wallet. No data was sent or stored. You can try again when you are ready.
walletAuthChallenge.errorDetail: Something went wrong while requesting your signature. Please try again.
walletAuthChallenge.footer: This signature is only valid for this session and expires shortly. SplitNaira never stores your private key.

hero.title: Agree the split once. Everyone gets paid the same way, every time.
hero.subtitle: SplitNaira lets Nigerian artists, producers, songwriters and their teams record who earns what from a song, film or project — then pays each collaborator their share automatically whenever money comes in.
hero.note: Free to use. You only pay the Stellar network fee for each transaction you sign.

preview.label: Illustrative example — not real account data

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Four steps from agreement to payout.

one.title: Connect your wallet
one.body: Sign in with a Stellar wallet such as Freighter. SplitNaira never asks for, sees or stores your secret key.

two.title: Create the split
two.body: Name the project, choose the token you are paid in, and add each collaborator’s address and share. Shares must add up to exactly 100%.

three.title: Deposit earnings
three.body: When royalties arrive, deposit them into the project. The balance is held by the smart contract, not by SplitNaira.

four.title: Distribute
four.body: Anyone can trigger a payout. The contract sends every collaborator their exact share in one transaction.

features.title: Built for creative teams
features.subtitle: Everything you need to keep collaborators paid fairly and on record.

projects.title: Projects
projects.body: One project per song, album, film or campaign, each with its own token, balance and payout history.

collaborators.title: Collaborators
collaborators.body: Add artists, producers, writers and managers by wallet address, with a readable alias for each.

allocation.title: Exact allocations
allocation.body: Shares are set in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), so a split like 33.33% is stored exactly. No rounding surprises.

tracking.title: Payment tracking
tracking.body: See balances, rounds and every payment sent, with a confirmation state for each transaction you sign.

transparency.title: Verifiable records
transparency.body: Every deposit and payout is a public Stellar transaction you can open in a block explorer.

control.title: Lock when final
control.body: When the agreement is settled, lock the project so the split can never be changed again.

stellar.title: Why Stellar and Soroban?
stellar.body: The split rules live in a Soroban smart contract on the Stellar network. Once a project is created, payouts follow those rules — SplitNaira cannot redirect funds or change shares on its own. Stellar transactions settle in seconds for a very small network fee.
stellar.caveat: A smart contract removes a middleman, not every risk: always double-check collaborator addresses before you create or lock a split.

items.nonCustodial: Non-custodial — your wallet signs every transaction
items.noFee: No platform fee taken from payouts
items.openSource: Open source under the MIT licence
items.status: In active development — try it on testnet first

currency.a: Payouts are in the Stellar token you choose when creating the project, such as XLM. The contract admin can restrict which tokens are allowed.

wallet.q: Does every collaborator need a wallet?
wallet.a: Yes. Each collaborator is identified by a Stellar address, which is where their share is sent.

change.q: Can a split be changed later?
change.a: The project owner can update collaborators and shares until the project is locked. Locking is permanent.

fees.a: SplitNaira does not take a cut. Each transaction you sign pays a small Stellar network fee in XLM.

failed.q: What happens if a transaction fails?
failed.a: Nothing is shown as paid until the network confirms it. If a transaction fails or its outcome is unknown, the app says so and blocks a duplicate submission until it is resolved.

cta.title: Ready to set up your first split?
cta.body: Connect a wallet and create a project in a few minutes.
